value.title: Maurice Constantin-Weyer
value.extract: Maurice Constantin-Weyer (French pronunciation: [mɔʁis kɔ̃stɑ̃tɛ̃ vɛjɛʁ] ; 24 April 1881, Bourbonne-les-Bains, Haute-Marne – 22 October 1964, Vichy, Allier) was a French writer. His best known novel is Un homme se penche sur son passé, Prix Goncourt 1928 (tr.: A Man Scans His Past, 1929).
